ns2:course.label: Clinical Practice III
ns2:course.description: Teaches clinical skills, practices, and procedures used in the Veterinary Teaching Hospital and the Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory and provides hands-on experience in the methodologies used to diagnose, treat, and prevent disease in animals. No graduate credit. 8 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VM 611.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No graduate credit. 8 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: VM 611.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Third Year class standing. Restricted to VetMed - Urbana-Champaign.
